<meta>continues from previous page</meta>superior to all the three realms <note>the realms of desire, form, and formlessness</note>, he dwelt within the palace of the essence of the <term>dharmadhatu</term> <gloss>the sphere of ultimate reality</gloss> which is free from conceptual elaboration. He was together with a great assembly of monks and a great gathering of <term>bodhisattvas</term> <gloss>beings dedicated to awakening</gloss>, such as: the <term>bodhisattva mahasattva</term> <gloss>great heroic being of awakening</gloss> Non-Conceptuality, and Non-Conceptual Radiance, and Non-Conceptual Moon, and Non-Conceptual Hero, and the one skilled in teaching the Non-Conceptual Dharma, and Non-Conceptual Essence, and Non-Conceptual <unclear>text ends mid-word</unclear>

<summary>This page describes the Buddha residing in the ultimate sphere of reality, surrounded by a great assembly of monks and specifically named bodhisattvas characterized by non-conceptual wisdom.</summary>
<keywords>Buddha, dharmadhatu, bodhisattva, non-conceptuality, three realms, assembly</keywords>
